bio: It's no wonder this place is so popular! The Gehrke family have made it a point of honour to uphold their long-standing tradition of offering outstanding cuisine, plus friendly service and an inviting atmosphere. The food is fresh, seasonal and made with select ingredients. The menu includes, for example, vegetable curry, roast corn-fed chicken breast with mushrooms or local game. There is also an impressive selection of schnitzels. Well-stocked wine cabinet. Attractive guestrooms at Schmiedegasthaus Gehrke....
